notes_for_editor: Only one source: the Central US Lookouts page, which gives the county, the agency and the location code, and marks the tower Removed. Two web searches and the local caches turned up nothing else about Cut. No build date, design, height, staffing or removal date is documented, so the story is deliberately short (about 50 words), well under the 120-word norm for thin evidence. Worth a look at Mark Twain National Forest or Wayne County local history if an editor wants more.
